headline: Caterpillar's $100M AI training pledge on a quiet Sunday
body: A quiet day. Caterpillar announced a five-year, $100 million programme to train 118,000 workers on AI, robotics and autonomy, a small plus for Shared Prosperity that nudged Egalitarian Utopia. Other endings drifted as earlier news faded. Horizon Balance stays at -4.92.
movers_note: No ending moved by a tenth of a point; Caterpillar's programme added 0.04 to Egalitarian Utopia.
